content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for a template that when applied to the given molecule (initial_molecule) reproduces the carbonyl-ene reaction retrosynthetically (i.e., break C=O and C=C to form C-O and C-C, forming a five-membered ring and hydroxyl). The search didn't find templates with those criteria. Maybe need to search without functional groups criteria, just get templates that match the molecule. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with no filters, just limit.
